changelog: Turn a TikTok creator homepage and recent posts into a collaboration brief still set.

en.description: Turn a TikTok creator homepage and recent posts into a collaboration brief still set. This TikTok creator brief studio reads the public profile and recent works, then lays out each already-written collab term as its own creator homepage brief card. Media buyers use it for TikTok creator briefs, collaboration brief stills, and a brief still pack they can hand off one file at a time.
en.summary: Turn a TikTok creator homepage and recent posts into a collaboration brief still set.
en.title: TikTok Creator Brief Stills: Homepage to Brief Cards
